briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent rollout intensifies global AGI competition with new compute deals

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race accelerates as frontier labs release iterative models while regulatory scrutiny mounts over deployment risks. Funding remains robust with infrastructure investments dominating Q3 flows. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production systems amid rapid scaling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus safety-tuned variant. Google DeepMind advances Gemini 3 preview while xAI expands Colossus cluster for Grok iterations. Meta and DeepSeek push open-weight releases.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New adversarial benchmarks reveal persistent jailbreak vectors across leading APIs. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units monthly as Microsoft and Google announce 2027 data center expansions. TSMC reports AI chip shortages persisting into Q4 with Samsung entering advanced packaging race.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols stabilize or amplify emergent misalignment risks by 2028?
